$comment: Every desk material maps to one swatch (docs/art-direction.md). color is the base colour in sRGB; textures are tinted and flattened towards it.

beige-plastic.use: Apple II case, monitor, disk drives, phone, lamp body

warm-grey.use: secondary plastics, keycap legends, the clock

near-black.use: keycaps, cameras, cables, floppy sleeves, clapper

dark-metal.use: small metal parts: hinges, screws, lens rings

brass.use: the globe stand, the bitcoin, lamp fittings

cream-paper.use: paper, notebook pages, labels, diploma, postcards

tomato.use: accent: the mug, the phone cord, one floppy label, the pins

mustard.use: accent: pencils, the tennis ball, a tape label

teal.use: accent: the Walkman, the cutting mat, a book

taylor-purple.use: only the Taylor pennant and the mortarboard

glass.use: lenses, the lamp bulb glass, the spectacles
